sections.title: Growth
sections.description: Revenue, earnings, and EPS across recent reporting periods.

metrics.label: Revenue
metrics.description: Revenue shows business scale and demand momentum.

metrics.label: Operating income
metrics.description: Operating income reflects core profitability after operating expenses.

metrics.label: Pretax income
metrics.description: Pretax income is earnings before income tax expense.

metrics.label: Net income
metrics.description: Net income is the profit remaining for shareholders.

metrics.label: EPS (diluted)
metrics.description: Earnings per share shows profit allocated to each share.

sections.title: Margins & efficiency
sections.description: ROE, ROA, and margin trends help assess earnings quality.

metrics.label: Gross margin
metrics.description: Gross margin reflects pricing power and direct cost control.

metrics.label: Operating margin
metrics.description: Operating margin shows operating efficiency after core expenses.

metrics.label: Net margin
metrics.description: Net margin shows how much revenue converts to bottom-line profit.

metrics.label: Operating expenses / revenue
metrics.description: Operating expense ratio; lower can indicate leaner operations.

sections.title: Balance sheet
sections.description: Asset scale, equity cushion, and debt levels.

metrics.label: Total assets
metrics.description: Total assets measure balance sheet scale.

metrics.label: Receivables
metrics.description: Receivables reflect credit extended to customers.

metrics.label: Stockholders' equity
metrics.description: Equity is the shareholder-owned capital cushion.

metrics.label: Short-term debt
metrics.description: Short-term borrowings due within one year.

sections.title: Leverage
sections.description: Debt relative to equity and assets when data is available.

metrics.label: Debt / equity
metrics.description: Debt-to-equity measures reliance on borrowing versus equity.

metrics.label: Debt / assets
metrics.description: Debt-to-assets shows how much of the balance sheet is debt-funded.

sections.title: Valuation
sections.description: Common market multiples and per-share valuation metrics.

metrics.label: P/E
metrics.description: Price-to-earnings shows how many times earnings the market pays.

metrics.label: P/B
metrics.description: Price-to-book compares market value to book equity.

metrics.label: P/S
metrics.description: Price-to-sales relates market cap to revenue.

metrics.label: EPS
metrics.description: Earnings per share used in valuation and growth analysis.

metrics.label: Book value per share
metrics.description: Book value per share is equity per share on the balance sheet.

metrics.label: EV / EBITDA
metrics.description: Enterprise value to EBITDA is a common capital-structure-aware multiple.
